newsitem.title: USA: Colgate gets final okay to buy Koylnos.
newsitem.headline: Colgate gets final okay to buy Koylnos.

text.p: Colgate-Palmolive Co said Wednesday it has completed the approval process for its purchase of the Kolynos business by Brazilian anti-trust authorities (CADE).

The company said official government agreement was given to previously reported plans developed by Colgate and CADE on how the company will operate the Kolynos toothpaste business in Brazil and how it will implement cost savings and expansion of export sales over the next several years.

Colgate purchased the worldwide Kolynos business in 1995 and in September 1996, CADE approved the acquisition in that country under certain alternative conditions. Several months ago, Colgate publicly selected the alternative proposed by CADE to suspend the sale of the Kolynos brand of toothpaste in Brazil for a period of four years.

Colgate said that, in its place, it will market an alternative brand in the same consumer segment now occupied by Kolynos. The company said it has has six months from today's approval to deplete existing Kolynos inventory and utilize existing packaging materials, during which time the alternative brand will be phased in.
